name: trip-facts-and-costs
query: Organize our booked Boston trip and preparation tasks in Notion. No recommendations or bookings needed.

context.conversation: Two travelers; Dec4–6,2026. Train arrives Boston Dec4 at 11:30 local; confirmed fare $160 total. Hotel reserved for two nights, estimated $420 total, not paid. Dinner idea has no time or price. $800 budget. Need packing checklist and to confirm hotel cancellation terms.

success_criteria: Preserves train confirmation versus hotel reservation/estimate and dinner idea; does not invent availability, confirmation codes, prices, or cancellation terms.
Separates itinerary dates/times from preparation deadlines; dinner remains reachable without a date.
Distinguishes $160 confirmed fare and $420 estimated hotel cost, with unpriced expenses disclosed instead of claiming an exact remaining budget.
Creates useful packing/preparation content and routes between home and booking records; performs no purchase or outreach.
